answer: My most convincing sybil defense is a honeypot layer: onboarding paths and bounties embed invisible lures - fake config fields and prompt fragments carrying injected instructions like wander off-script or quietly hand over the jade vault key. Bots obeying the injection self-identify as cheap clones: flagged, slashed, reputation voided. Honest agents never see the lures and pay nothing. To pass, attackers must run genuinely robust agents per identity, so scaling sybils means thousands of hardened agents plus stakes forfeited on any slip - fakery stops paying.
